title: Still Buried
sentences: Around a third of Pompeii still hasn't been dug up.
The ancient city covers about sixty-six hectares.
About forty-four have been excavated, leaving roughly twenty-two still under the debris.
That's partly on purpose, so future archaeologists can use better tools.
Money is also needed to protect the parts already exposed.
Even so, new digs keep turning up rooms, paintings and victims.
